title: SMProfile-Quant payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/material/quant.json 3.2.0; do not edit by hand. Envelope: standard/payloads/envelope.schema.json.

quant_no.description: Unique Quant id (quant_id of the WMS row).

article_ref.description: Article (artikel_nr) — join key to Article / OperationsResponse for material availability.

quantity.description: Stock quantity (menge). For material availability it is summed filtered on blocked==0.

blocked.description: Block flag (gesperrt): 0 = freely available, !=0 = blocked. Filter for the material_unavailable aggregation (only free stock counts).

updated_at.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.
